title: Agent Postings
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:59 AM

Icon                                                       Status                                                    Meaning

[hag                                                       X                                                         Item could not be processed

al                                                             Cc                                                                Payment was reversed

eS                                                    D                                                       Reversal in repetition

at                                                        E                                                          Payment reversed, no posting necessary
ie                                                              P                                                                Payment posted, document exists

&                                                                   Cc                                                                      Reversal unsuccessful, payment lot created

(The system was unable to post the reversal
and has therefore created a corresponding

reversal payment lot for the reversal.)

Using the pushbuttons in the toolbar above the table, you can do the following:

Pushbutton                                                                                  Function

zeXl                                                                                              Direct call of Xl message for a payment
(E>Repeat                                                                                 Repeat posting of a payment or repeat reversal
a+ In Payment Lot                                                                  Addition of items to payment lots

GePayment Lot                                                                      Display of payment lots

meNote to Payee                                                                    Display of payment usage information specified

(PaymentExplanation) for a payment

[F@Agent Information                                                                   Call of information for external cash desks

You can post payments with status R and X by choosing |sPayments » External Cash Desk Services » Repeat External
Payments/Reversals 3 (transaction FKKEXC_RETRY) in the SAP Easy Access screen.

By double-clicking on the corresponding symbol for an item, you can display the last message for an entry.
Agent Postings

This tab page displays all payments for a grouping key. Here you can monitor individual payments of a grouping or individual X|
messages. To reach a specific balance, you can manually post differences for a grouping key.

Cash Journal Operations

Here you can display information on all postings in the cash journal, along with their status. In addition, you can repeat the posting
for postings that were not successful, or set their status to Manual Postprocessing Required. After manual posting has taken
place, you can set the status Manual Clarification here. You can also update all postings received using enterprise services.

Cash Balance

The tab page shows the cash balance for all postings. You can check the cash balance at two different levels - for the branch or for
